title: Studio: check-only re-run — 'done --recheck' re-judges in ~0.2s instead of re-rendering

log.text: Added store.createRecheckRun (copies a rendered run's outputs into a new run, only the check step left to run) and queue.enqueueRecheck (picks the newest rendered run; full-run fallback when nothing is rendered). execute() runs only the check process for a checkOnly run. work 'done --recheck' flags the item; the watcher calls enqueueRecheck instead of a full enqueue.

TDD across store/queue/work/CLI: full studio suite 278/278 green. Real end-to-end through the actual queue and run_check.py on a copy of run 20261023-192819-61eb: new check-only run done in 0.28s, steps read..stills copied/done + check fresh, summary 20/5/4, no Blender spawned.

summary: Check-logic fixes now re-judge in ~0.2s via 'done --recheck'; a full 'done' still re-renders. No exercises listed here, so nothing re-ran.
rerunNote: No exercises were listed, so nothing re-ran.
